description: This file defines a React hook 'useProgressiveExpand' and a utility function 'createProgressiveExpandController' for progressively processing large batches of work in a non-blocking manner. It manages progress state, supports cancellation, and uses requestIdleCallback or setTimeout as fallback for timing control.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller to process items in batches asynchronously, scheduling work with requestIdleCallback or setTimeout, with progress callbacks and cancel capability.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: React hook that wraps the controller to provide UI state management for progressive processing, including progress, running state, and controls to start or cancel the process.
